```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to seek better negotiated trade agreements that put America first.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When trade agreements are carefully negotiated with friendly democracies, they have resulted in millions of new jobs in the United States supported by U.S. exports.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trade agreements that do not adequately protect U.S. interests or U.S. sovereignty must be rejected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trade agreements that are violated with impunity must be rejected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States cannot allow foreign governments to limit American access to their markets while stealing U.S. designs, patents, brands, know-how, and technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States cannot allow China to continue its currency manipulation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States cannot allow China to exclude U.S. products from government purchases.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States cannot allow China to subsidize Chinese companies to thwart American imports.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's approach to dealing with violations of world trade standards has been a virtual surrender.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president will insist on parity in trade.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president will stand ready to implement countervailing duties if other countries refuse to cooperate.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to broaden trade agreements with countries which share values and commitment to fairness, along with transparency in commercial and business practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The American people demand transparency, full disclosure, protection of national sovereignty, and tough negotiation on the part of those who are supposed to advance the interests of U.S. workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Significant trade agreements should not be rushed or undertaken in a Lame Duck Congress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
